headline.text: L3 ML4 lost Saturday coverage when *all operators called out* — mold rotation skipped, Monday readiness questioned.

per_plant_summary.L1: Saturday cleaning shifts cleared four quick fixes across Sollich 1–4, including a metal detector noise issue and a bark breaker that still needs final tooth cleaning Monday.
per_plant_summary.L2: No activity in the last 24 hours.
per_plant_summary.L3: ML4 completed a level 2 clean but lost all Saturday operators — mold rotation didn't happen and management is asking whether first shift needs early arrival Monday. TG3 threw a conveyor misalignment error overnight with no clear fix, and the truffle line needs wire mesh replacement Monday morning.

resolved.title: Sollich 1 metal detector noise on incline conveyor
resolved.summary: Electrical noise was triggering false rejects; electricians installed shielded cable on the incline conveyor.
resolved.resolution: Fixed by electricians at 09:56 — "finished putting shielded cable on the incline conveyor and it appears to have fixed the noise" (Matt Hatch).

resolved.title: Sollich 4 Conbar not cleaned after first shift
resolved.summary: Katya walked the line and found the Conbar hadn't been cleaned and tools were left unsigned.
resolved.resolution: Cleaned by overnight at 22:25 — "Conbar has been cleaned, we just need it to be tested" (Conner Boyd).

resolved.title: Sollich 3 capper had tape on it
resolved.summary: Capper was found with tape on it and needed adjustment to run correctly.
resolved.resolution: Fixed at 16:50 — "Removed the tape and adjusted it correctly" (Caleb York).

resolved.title: Wiring cable by C7 not secured, touching floor
resolved.summary: Chad Stone flagged loose cable touching the floor near C7 as a safety hazard.
resolved.resolution: Fixed at 23:19 — Caleb York "found a part that has it re-secured keeping it off the ground" (Conner Boyd).

resolved.title: ML4 belts S3 and M2 stopped
resolved.summary: Two belts weren't running; Jose was called to diagnose and repair.
resolved.resolution: Fixed at 07:57 — "Jose told me. He was able to fix the the 2 belts (S3 & M2)" (Raoul Lubain).

needs_attention.title: Sollich 2 bark breaker teeth cleaning incomplete
needs_attention.summary: Bark breaker passed visual inspection except for teeth, which still need final cleaning before full sign-off.
needs_attention.status: Deferred to Monday start — MD is in place and won't interfere with CPK order, teeth cleaning to finish during startup.

needs_attention.title: TG3 conveyor 2 misalignment error
needs_attention.summary: TG3 threw an error message indicating conveyor 2 is misaligned; no follow-up on whether it was cleared.
needs_attention.status: Error reported at 00:13; no resolution or update in the thread as of window close.

needs_attention.title: ML4 Saturday shift — all operators called out
needs_attention.summary: Line lead Anthony and all scheduled operators didn't show up Saturday, preventing mold rotation in the WDS and raising Monday readiness concerns.
needs_attention.status: Rose Smuin asking pointed questions at 11:01 and 11:21 about who worked, whether Monday needs early arrival, and missing ATP areas.

needs_attention.title: Truffle line enrober wire mesh replacement needed
needs_attention.summary: Rose Smuin requested wire mesh replacement on the TL enrober and asked if it could be done Saturday.
needs_attention.status: Scheduled for Monday morning with delayed line start — 2 hours planned, parts in stock (Chris Givens, 11:40).
